# Impeccable Companion

Impeccable is not vendored in this v1 package.

Recommended source:

```text
https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable
path: .agents/skills/impeccable
license: Apache-2.0
```

If vendored later, preserve the upstream `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` files.

Use Impeccable for UI/UX craft when available. If missing, use `design-system-steward` as the fallback.
